tolerance: relative 1e-9 on every number (same formulae, double precision); exact on usage categories and class letters; headline tiles must show the rounded annual kWh and the overall class; saturation flag exact; worked examples and certificates must match the printed numbers within the rounding of their printed inputs (0.6 % Barney & Lorente with unrounded kL and s_av, 0.02 mWh/(kg m) VDI draft example, 0.1-0.2 % certificates)

provenance_note: Expected values were computed by bench-src/ref/gen_liftenergy.py, an independent Python implementation written from ISO 25745-2:2015 Tables 1-7 (Table 2 per the 2015 text, Amd.1:2023 not read; hydraulic kL with the ISO/DIS sign +), Formulae (1)-(18) and Annex B (licensed text, bw-r1 D-BW-8), VDI 4707 Blatt 1 (2009) Tables 1-3 and Eq. 1 as reprinted by Zukunft Bau (2015) and the VDI 4707 draft (2007) Tables 1-4 (legacy); not from the page code. The worked examples and two VDI 4707-1:2009 certificates are also compared with the numbers printed in those sources; the ref itself recomputes the Barney & Lorente examples with their rounded inputs (kL, s_av) to <= 0.05 % or the printed whole Wh.
